promptEs: En Do mayor, ¿qué cifrado tiene la tríada diatónica del grado IV?
promptEn: In C major, what is the symbol of the diatonic triad on degree IV?
explanationEs: En Do mayor, el grado IV se construye sobre Fa: Fa-La-Do. La tercera Fa-La es mayor y la quinta Fa-Do es justa, así que la tríada es mayor y se cifra Fa.
explanationEn: In C major, degree IV is built on F: F-A-C. The third F-A is major and the fifth F-C is perfect, so the triad is major and its symbol is F.
